settings.petDock.title: Pet quota dock
settings.petDock.labelsHint: Turn off “Show text labels” to display larger values only.
settings.petDock.description: Show quota under the official pet, with conversation cards below the dock. The dock scales and moves with the pet.
settings.petDock.metrics: Accounts show five-hour and weekly quota left. API providers show balance and total tokens.
settings.petDock.waitingForCodex: Waiting for Codex. Enable ChatGPT enhancements, then launch or restart Codex through Remote AI.
settings.petDock.waitingForPet: Connected. Open the official pet to show the dock.
settings.petDock.unavailable: Could not update the dock. Please retry later.
settings.petDock.unsupported: This feature requires the official Codex pet on Windows or macOS.
settings.petDock.cloudHint: On the computer with the pet, open Remote AI → Settings → Usage to enable this feature.
settings.petDock.loadError: Could not load settings. Please retry.
settings.petDock.averageHint: Enable All-account average in the pet dock settings on that computer to switch both widgets.
